summary.oneLiner: Among the leading global manufacturers of machinery and equipment for technical textiles by revenue in 2024, with a 15.4% share of the global woven Raffia machinery market by value and a 40.7% share of the domestic woven Raffia machines market by value in Fiscal 2025.
summary.business: Lohia Corp Limited manufactures machinery and equipment for technical textiles, focused on solutions for producing polypropylene (PP) and high-density polyethylene (HDPE) woven fabric and sacks ("Raffia"), and provides end-to-end 'concept to commissioning' solutions across the woven fabric production lifecycle. Its machines are sold to producers of woven fabric used in packaging (cement, fertilizer, chemicals, polymer, food grain, minerals) and non-packaging applications, supplied to around 100 countries through an exclusive global sales network.
